about_the_game:
One More Time

A brutal parkour journey driven by purpose, pain, and persistence.

In One More Time, you're not just running a course — you're chasing a promise. After years of relentlessly trying to complete the world’s most challenging obstacle island, a loving father grows old and weak. His final attempt ends in the hospital, where — with his last breath — he asks his son to finish what he couldn’t.

Now, you step into the shoes of that son.

This is not just about winning. It’s about honoring a legacy.

🔑 Features:

  • Two Ways to Play:

    • Casual Mode – With checkpoints to help you progress.

    • Hardcore Mode – No checkpoints. No forgiveness. One mistake, and it's back to the beginning.

  • Mixed Gameplay:
    Navigate deadly courses on foot and behind the wheel, mastering a variety of mechanics across diverse terrains.

  • Emotional Core:
    Experience a minimalist but powerful story through the environment, pacing, and memory-driven progress — no cutscenes, no dialogue, just raw purpose.

  • Surprises in Every Turn:
    Expect the unexpected. Every new section brings fresh twists and gameplay surprises to test your adaptability.

  • A Challenge That Matters:
    Whether you play for the thrill, the emotion, or to prove yourself — this is a game that makes every fall hurt, and every victory feel earned.

He couldn’t finish it.
Will you dare to try… One More Time?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600@ 3.1 GHz or AMD R5 1600X @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 3.1 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 2600x 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

short_description: A fast-paced, story-driven parkour game where you switch between vehicles and on-foot challenges to conquer deadly courses with no checkpoints — unless you choose the easy way.
